$description: Component recipes of the atelier preset. 'class' is the suffix after the DS class prefix (acme- + btn). 'react' and 'vue' name the shadcn/ui and shadcn-vue components that render the DS through the alias layer (install names in brackets). 'source': preset = atelier recipe (dark-first surfaces with an inset sheen, brand colour only for accents and the selected state); composed = Material Design 3 structure built with preset tokens.

components.name: Button
components.notes: Primary is the one accent on the screen: keep one primary button per view. Secondary is the glass surface button.

components.name: Icon button
components.notes: Needs aria-label. 48 px touch target on touch screens.

components.name: Floating action button
components.structure: Material 3 FAB: 56 px, small 40 px, extended with label; one per screen; above the tab bar on compact windows.

components.name: Field
components.notes: Children: .label, .helper. Label is always visible; placeholder is never the label.

components.name: Select
components.react: NativeSelect (native-select); Select (select) for a custom list
components.vue: NativeSelect (native-select); Select (select) for a custom list
components.notes: HTML: wrapper span.select around a native <select>.

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: Wrap in label.choice for a 48 px target on touch screens.

components.name: Chip / tag
components.structure: Material 3 filter and input chips: 32 px high, leading check when selected, trailing remove button on input chips.
components.vue: Toggle variant="outline" (toggle); TagsInput, TagsInputItem (tags-input) for input chips
components.notes: Selected state uses the brand colour (text, stroke, tint) plus a check mark, never colour alone.

components.name: Segmented control
components.structure: Material 3 segmented button: 2-5 joined segments, check icon on the selected one, single or multi select.
components.notes: Selected state uses the brand colour plus a check mark.

components.name: Tabs
components.notes: Children: .tab, .tab-panel. Scrolls sideways when tabs do not fit. Selected tab uses the brand colour (text, stroke, tint).

components.name: Top bar
components.structure: Material 3 small top app bar: 64 px, leading navigation icon, title, up to 3 trailing actions.

components.name: Navigation rail
components.structure: Material 3 navigation rail: 80 px wide, 3-7 destinations, pill indicator 56 x 32, optional FAB on top. Shown on medium and expanded windows.
components.react: Sidebar collapsible="icon" (sidebar) is the closest; use the DS class for the rail
components.vue: Sidebar collapsible="icon" (sidebar) is the closest; use the DS class for the rail

components.name: Bottom tab bar
components.structure: Material 3 navigation bar (short, 64 px): 3-5 destinations, pill indicator. Shown on compact windows instead of the rail.

components.name: Menu
components.notes: Children: .menu-item, .menu-sep, .menu-label. HTML demo opens it with details.dropdown.

components.name: Card
components.react: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter (card)
components.vue: Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter (card)

components.name: List
components.structure: Material 3 list rows: one line 56 px, two line 72 px at density 0; leading media, trailing meta or action.
components.react: ItemGroup, Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions (item)
components.vue: ItemGroup, Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions (item)

components.name: Table
components.react: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell (table)
components.vue: Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell (table)
components.notes: Wrap in .table-wrap: scrolls sideways inside its frame, never the page.

components.name: Empty state
components.react: Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, EmptyContent (empty)
components.vue: Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, EmptyContent (empty)

components.name: Dialog
components.react: Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter (dialog); AlertDialog (alert-dialog)
components.vue: Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogDescription, DialogFooter (dialog); AlertDialog (alert-dialog)
components.notes: HTML: native <dialog>. Footer buttons stack full width on compact windows.

components.name: Bottom sheet
components.structure: Material 3 modal bottom sheet: drag handle, large top corners, max 640 px wide and centred on wider windows.

components.name: Toast
components.structure: Material 3 snackbar placement: bottom, above the tab bar on compact windows, one at a time, optional single action.

components.name: Tooltip
components.notes: Host: .tooltip-host. Never the only place for essential text (touch screens have no hover).
